Whole-home surge protection was also installed to provide an additional layer of protection against damaging voltage surges and electrical spikes that can affect appliances, electronics, and other sensitive equipment throughout the home.

As an additional measure to help prevent future water intrusion, the entire new service assembly was carefully sealed. All areas where electrical wiring, conduit, or other piping enter the home were fully sealed with silicone, along with the appropriate service entry points and exterior equipment connections.
